basics.name: Laura Schmidt
basics.label: Physical Therapist
basics.summary: Licensed physical therapist with eight years in orthopaedic and sports rehabilitation. I help people get back to what they love, and stay there.

work.name: Lakeshore Sports Rehab
highlights: Treat 14 patients a day, mostly after knee and shoulder surgery.
Built a return-to-run programme; 85% of patients ran again within six months.
Supervise physical therapy students from two universities.

work.name: Northwestern Memorial Hospital
highlights: Helped cut average stay after hip replacement by a day with early mobility.
